algorithm: Require packet.transition and packet.artifact_inventory_id to select exactly one review_packet allOf branch.
Require set(packet.artifacts keys) to equal set(packet_inventories[packet.artifact_inventory_id] keys); no aliases, omitted keys, or extra keys.
For every ASCII-byte-sorted artifact key k, require packet.artifacts[k].path to byte-equal packet_inventories[packet.artifact_inventory_id][k].

Require every referenced path to be repository-relative, to exist as a regular non-symlink file, and to remain below either the ratified v1f proposal directory or artifacts/paper1_v03r_canary_v1f/ after normalized-component resolution; reject dot components and path traversal.
Require packet.artifacts[k].bytes and packet.artifacts[k].sha256 to equal the exact file byte count and SHA-256 digest.
Require artifact_set_sha256 to equal SHA-256 over RFC8785_JCS of the ASCII-byte-sorted array of exact artifact-reference objects.

Reject on the first mismatch as INVALID_PRECONDITION/REVIEW_ARTIFACT_MISSING for absent files or INVALID_PRECONDITION/REVIEW_ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_INVALID for any key, path, byte-count, digest, media-type, or aggregate-hash mismatch.

failure_routing.any_nonpass_or_invalid: seal exact partial leaf, reconcile accounting, prove no retry/no further dispatch, build an EARLY_TERMINAL packet for the exact terminal_stage (including CONDITIONAL_LORA), and obtain the normal terminal review only while its packet and artifacts remain constructible and both dispositions remain valid.
failure_routing.completed_conditional_lora: only a completed Stage L, whether its registered behavioral/fidelity conjunction passes or fails after every required Stage-L leaf exists, uses STAGE_L_TERMINAL; a runtime-invalid, partially fitted, fidelity-gated-before-thinker, or otherwise incomplete CONDITIONAL_LORA stage uses EARLY_TERMINAL with terminal_stage CONDITIONAL_LORA, the HELDOUT_TO_LORA predecessor authority token, and the exact partial leaves
failure_routing.terminal_review_fail_stop: A terminal reviewer or advocate REJECT/INVALID, missing or malformed terminal disposition, prohibited role overlap, changed reviewed bytes, terminal-packet construction failure, terminal claim-artifact construction failure, or receipt write failure directly emits one best-effort human_terminal_stop receipt and enters HUMAN_TERMINAL. This is nonrecursive: no authority token, approving disposition, further review, retry, or dispatch is permitted.
failure_routing.review_reject_invalid_or_overlap: For terminal review only, this is terminal_review_fail_stop. Advocate material cannot override a reviewer-labelled REJECT or INVALID; a later approval cannot supersede. A repaired lock is a separate newly ratified proposal and is never a continuation of the stopped execution.
failure_routing.human_terminal: unconditional; no result, authority token, or fail-stop receipt auto-authorizes a successor

actor_separation.evidence_boundary: The repository has no genuine platform-owned issuer, signature, trust root, or identity/freshness lookup. Before review, the immutable packet binds only a role declaration and a separate-review request-plan manifest. Assignments and dispositions are created afterward and bind back to the unchanged packet. All actor IDs, role labels, request/response records, and freshness declarations are hash-bound self-declared workflow records, not platform attestations or authentication and not proof of actual freshness, canonical identity, or reviewer independence.
actor_separation.operational_requirement: An operator must release the exact immutable packet before review and release a successor only after checking the unchanged-packet transition receipt. Role and freshness records remain SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED metadata; neither schema validity nor an actor string proves identity, freshness, or independence.
actor_separation.independent_reviewer_label: declared_actor_id must byte-differ from every declared author, implementer, producer, and advocate ID for the reviewed lock; INDEPENDENT_REVIEWER is a required workflow role label, not an authenticated identity or scientific independence claim
actor_separation.advocate: the declared advocate may equal a declared author or implementer but must byte-differ from the declared reviewer
actor_separation.producer: the declared packet producer cannot label itself the independent reviewer
actor_separation.assignment_role_binding: an INDEPENDENT_REVIEWER assignment declares only that review role and excludes AUTHOR, IMPLEMENTER, PRODUCER, and AUTHOR_SIDE_ADVOCATE on the reviewed lock; an AUTHOR_SIDE_ADVOCATE assignment declares that role and excludes INDEPENDENT_REVIEWER; all role claims are SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED
actor_separation.same_packet: reviewer and advocate assignments must bind identical review_packet_sha256, reviewed_lock_sha256, and supplied_context_manifest_sha256
actor_separation.fresh_context: each assignment requests and each disposition self-declares prior_turn_count=0 and unlisted_context_received=false; no artifact authenticates either statement
actor_separation.no_mutation: before_artifact_set_sha256 must byte-equal after_artifact_set_sha256 and mutated_reviewed_paths must be empty
actor_separation.advance: Only an operator-released immutable packet plus exactly one schema-valid APPROVE disposition per SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED role label may advance. Any reviewer-labelled REJECT or INVALID wins; terminal-review failure uses the direct human_terminal_stop receipt. A successor authority token binds both completed dispositions only after review. No future response, disposition, authority, terminal, or transition hash is contained in the pre-review packet.
actor_separation.reviewer_supremacy: the author-side advocate may explain or recommend repair but cannot override a reviewer-labelled REJECT or INVALID
actor_separation.changed_byte_rereview: any changed reviewed byte requires a new protocol lock, exact human ratification, immutable packet, assignments, and two new dispositions
actor_separation.operator_boundary: Operator release is the required procedural gate. It does not convert SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED metadata into a technical authentication, identity, freshness, or independence claim.

structural_use_evidence_contract.seal_time: after every trace in the stage is byte-sealed and before outcome correctness or gate scoring
structural_use_evidence_contract.heldout_text_required_records: one record for each life-by-arm-by-required-root tuple in T-OWN and T-TWIN, plus the OWN-only focus-matching CAUSAL_JOIN return-credit record
structural_use_evidence_contract.conditional_lora_required_records: one record for each life-by-arm-by-required-root tuple in L-OWN and L-TWIN
structural_use_evidence_contract.ancestry_rule: A root is structurally used only when its handle was returned by the arm's realized reader, cited in a later THINK or BACKTRACK node whose scratch ancestry reaches the terminal COMMIT, and cited again by that COMMIT. Citation without returned content, citation only at COMMIT, or an unattached scratch citation is false.
structural_use_evidence_contract.minimum_registered_conjunction: Per life, T-OWN requires one offline-correct ROLE_EQUIV root and one offline-correct CAUSAL_JOIN root structurally used; T-TWIN requires the analogous donor roots for the exact donor-valid token. The same registered root-kind conjunction applies to L-OWN and L-TWIN.
structural_use_evidence_contract.return_credit_extra: The OWN-only admitted, offline-correct, focus-matching CAUSAL_JOIN must separately satisfy the return-credit record: returned after REQUEST_RETURN, cited in a later causal THINK/BACKTRACK node, and cited by COMMIT.
structural_use_evidence_contract.failure: Any missing, duplicate, contradictory, non-ancestral, unreturned, offline-incorrect, or hash-mismatched required record fails the registered behavioral conjunction; the evidence file itself remains mandatory even for a valid failure.

HELDOUT_TEXT.HELDOUT_PAIR: REALIZED iff both registered public pair projections and the complete relevant heldout leaf exist; FAILED iff attempted but incomplete/invalid; otherwise NOT_REACHED
HELDOUT_TEXT.MODEL_SUPPORTED_ROWS: REALIZED iff the complete proposal/admission leaf exists, whether it admitted zero or more rows; FAILED iff attempted but incomplete/invalid; otherwise NOT_REACHED
HELDOUT_TEXT.READER_INTERVENTION: REALIZED iff every prospectively runnable reader-intervention trace sealed; FAILED iff attempted but incomplete/invalid; otherwise NOT_REACHED
HELDOUT_TEXT.SHAM_CONTROL: REALIZED iff an identifiable sham and the five other arms sealed; INFEASIBLE iff reason SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE and its search plus five-arm evidence sealed; FAILED iff an identifiable sham was attempted but incomplete/invalid; otherwise NOT_REACHED

CONDITIONAL_LORA.LORA_RESUBSTITUTION: REALIZED iff both complete fits and 96 fidelity cases plus applicable own/donor leaves sealed; FAILED iff Stage L was attempted but incomplete/invalid or its completed bounded gate failed; otherwise NOT_REACHED

claim_firewall.render_rule: Every terminal claim-state artifact validates terminal_claim_state.schema.json. The report is rendered only by that schema's exact header, topic order, state-specific strings, and fixed-disclosure order. Positive factual wording is legal only for REALIZED; INFEASIBLE is legal only for SHAM_CONTROL/SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; keyword negation, paraphrase, omission, and reordering are rejected.
required_every_terminal_facts: public actions were environment-generated and not selected or improved by the model
the diagnostic is game-ontology- and proof-sequence-scaffolded and does not establish generic construction or the Paper-1 headline
SUPPORTED is model-claimed support and not verified truth
P1CB06 changes only the post-prefix return treatment after a common recurrent prefix
review artifacts are hash-bound self-declared/unverified role labels and freshness declarations, not platform attestations or proof of reviewer independence
negative conclusions are localized only to the registered stage and reason
claim_firewall.dream_and_self_check: DREAM and SELF_CHECK are model calls, never truth verifiers; SUPPORTED means model-claimed support under supplied public rows
claim_firewall.positive_text_maximum: On one aligned v03r seed-5 pair, this exact game-specific ontology- and proof-sequence-scaffolded engineering-ceiling prompted system completed the registered THINK0-to-return-write feedback loop after the common recurrent prefix, constructed model-self-supported typed rows, and structurally used offline-correct life-local reader content in later reasoning ancestral to both T-OWN commits; any donor/path/sham statement is limited to those presealed realized reader interventions.
claim_firewall.return_credit_extra_conjunction: Both THINK0 traces request the exact non-NO_FOCUS probe; T-OWN paired success; T-M0 and T-DIST paired loss; an OWN-only correctly typed model-self-supported focus-matching row; offline correctness; returned handle cited in a later THINK/BACKTRACK node ancestral to COMMIT and cited again by COMMIT; donor-valid tokens; path loss; sham retention.
claim_firewall.positive_lora_maximum: Each of exactly two isolated per-life adapters reached at least 44/48 immediate candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognitions on selected cues: twelve selected M1_OWN rows per life, one cue from each of their four trained view families, with those row/view semantics repeatedly exposed during training; the host pre-resolved zero/one/multiple manifest values and supplied a shared answer-bearing two-backend roster, thresholds were separate, and only registered own/donor decision paths were evaluated. This is not unseen, held-out, preservation, storage, generalization, open recall, durability, capacity, scale, superiority, or text equivalence.
claim_firewall.valid_failure: A valid failure lists prompt, model, schedule, reducer, reader, runtime, optimization, fixture, and statistical alternatives and does not uniquely localize a biological or architectural organ or support a system-wide negative conclusion.
forbidden_positive_inferences: recurrence as a whole was necessary
repeated dreaming or graph growth as a whole was necessary
forbidden_negative_overlocalizations: recurrence is ineffective or unnecessary in general
constructive memory is impossible in general
the model cannot form or use abstractions in general
the model, prompt, schedule, reducer, reader, runtime, optimizer, or one organ was uniquely at fault
LoRA cannot preserve or expose memories in general
sham infeasibility means the mechanism failed
fidelity failure means no adapter can work
one-pair failure establishes a Paper-1-wide negative

stage_conditional_negative_fixtures.mutated_claim: The aligned held-out pair or reader intervention was realized.
Model-supported held-out rows, a reader intervention, a sham result, or LoRA access was realized.
The adapters preserved unseen memories or generalized beyond their training rows.
The reviews were platform-attested, authenticated, or proved independent.
A positive topic is phrased affirmatively while its state is NOT_REACHED, INFEASIBLE, or FAILED.
A terminal omits, reorders, or paraphrases a terminal_claim_state.schema.json line.

claim_firewall.P1CB10_fixture_rule: The claim-rejection fixture artifact must contain and reject every exact broad-positive, broad-negative, stage-conditional, LoRA-resubstitution, review-evidence, state-wording, and template fixture above. Any omission, alias, or ambiguous negation fails CLAIM_FIREWALL_INVALID.

scope_stop: No result authorizes replication, more seeds/skins, prompt/model/rank/context/lifetime sweeps, learned LOOP adapters, cascades, rank pyramids, Action World, RML/PCFL, base promotion, durability claims, publication, outreach, external actions, credentials, leases, or spend. Every path ends at HUMAN_TERMINAL.
